title: One-step finite replacement extension
statement: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme X, an etale hypercover K [def-weil-pbc-etale-hypercover], and any replacement stage A through n [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-replacement-stage], there exists a replacement stage B through n+1 whose restriction to n is A.

source.place: 0DAV and 01GJ, successor step; 094K, finite affine choices.

proof.text: Construct the qcqs universal next matching scheme of A.
Pull back the matching cover of K and select its finite affine relative cover, with its map to K and all boundary equations.
Attach that prescribed relative cover to A, retaining all old data. This gives B with restriction exactly A.

theorem exists_replacement_stage_extension
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (K : SimplicialObject X.Etale) (hK : IsEtaleHypercover K)
    (n : ℕ) (A : FiniteSplitReplacementStage K n) :
    ∃ B : FiniteSplitReplacementStage K (n + 1), B.restrict n (Nat.le_succ n) = A
